notes: Two teams, shared loadouts and most-kills-on-a-timer is Team Deathmatch, and the round-based lobby does not make this Party & Casual — the game is guns and sightlines. I swapped the preset's lane-network for space-staged because the vote happens in a waiting area players then teleport out of, and because the answers say the three maps should differ (open, close-quarters, vertical) rather than share one lane layout, so a single lane shape would be a lie about two of the three. P4 is earned outright here by the teleport and the three distinct arenas, so there is no continuous-map override to apply; cover-elevated covers the vertical map and stays tiered rather than overhanging. Without a user I took the military theme from the answers, treated the 130-second timer, the 30-second minigun and the sniper/grenade loadout as gameplay with no layout geometry, and read the spawns as two shielded team bases per arena.
